GitInfoSettings.PatDescription: GitHub Personal Access Token for authenticated API access. Required for private repos and higher rate limits.
GitInfoSettings.RefreshIntervalDescripti: How often the tool window automatically refreshes data from the provider.
GitInfoSettings.AzureDevOps.PatDescripti: Azure DevOps Personal Access Token with Code (Read) and Work Items (Read) scopes.
GitInfoSettings.AzureDevOps.MainProjectD: Central project where work items are tracked. Leave empty to use the project from the remote URL.
GitInfoSettings.AzureDevOps.TagFilterDes: Tag to filter work items by. Leave empty to use the project name from the remote URL.
GitInfoSettings.AzureDevOps.StatesDescri: Comma-separated work item states to include (e.g. New,Active,Resolved).
GitInfoSettings.AzureDevOps.AssignedToDe: Filter work items by assigned person. Use @me for the PAT owner. Leave empty for all.
